column3: Retains the commandment in the singular.
Retains as He spoke rather than promised.
Retains the shift to singular address when coating the stones.
Retains waving iron over them without explicitly supplying tool.
Retains the separate acts of sacrificing, eating, and rejoicing.
Retains and between the carved and molten images.
Retains and between father and mother.
Retains boundary without explicitly supplying stone.
Retains causing the blind to wander.
Retains a soul of innocent blood.
Retains establishing the words in order to do them.
